title: Tell HN: You can have separate agent account on GitHub
summary:
You can have a separate GitHub account for your agent (GitHub ToS actually allows that since April) and that account can fork your repo and open PRs. This way it cannot do any real damage but can still push.

See this user for example: https://github.com/filippo-agent

https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/github-terms/github-terms-of-service#3-account-requirements

3. Account Requirements

We have a few simple rules for Accounts on GitHub's Service.

You must be a human to create an Account. Accounts registered by "bots" or other automated methods are not permitted. We do permit machine accounts:

A machine account is an Account set up by an individual human who accepts the Terms on behalf of the Account, provides a valid email address, and is responsible for its actions. A machine account is used exclusively for performing automated tasks. Multiple users may direct the actions of a machine account, but the owner of the Account is ultimately responsible for the machine's actions. You may maintain no more than one free machine account in addition to your free Personal Account.

One person or legal entity may maintain no more than one free Account (if you choose to control a machine account as well, that's fine, but it can only be used for running a machine).

title: Tell HN: Be Careful with Stripe Connect
summary:
TLDR - stripe made it easy for fraudsters to syphon $4,500 through our stripe account and withdraw all of it - and they expect us to cover everything and have offered absolutely zero help.

I’ve been building on top of stripe for 15 years and have made about 70 products for clients using stripe.

I just had an incident with a project where fraudsters were able to route $4.5k worth of charges through our stripe account and withdrew all of the funds. I structured an overall secure system - there was very little negligence on our side - and it all happened so fast.

Stripe support has been very surprising - you only get to speak to folks in the Philippines and they are of absolutely zero help. They told us we are fully responsible even though they gave us no alerts or warnings the issue was happening. They expect us to cover the full 4.5k, they will not help us with the stripe fees or chargeback fees.

It’s almost like they incentivize the fraud. It’s so disappointing. Stripe used to be such a decent company - it’s like they lost their soul…

Lesson - there’s not much of an alternative to stripe - but if you ever use stripe connect just know they will absolutely sell you out…

Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50398646

title: A new protocol and software suite for AIs
summary:
I was tired of copy/pasting back and forth from ChatGPT to my terminal, so I created Pigeon-Home.ai

Homing Pigeon is both a protocol and a software (daemon) which gives major cloud AI vendors a signed and secure channel to your CPU/memory.

Project: https://github.com/Pigeon-Home/homing-pigeon

IETF Draft https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-slutsky-homing-pigeon/

Feedback welcome and do not worry novice users, it's HIGHLY secure.

Here is my CV: https://github.com/Pigeon-Home/homing-pigeon/blob/main/docs/archive/resume.txt

This protocol and software are 'basically' unhackable!

Try this prompt in your cloud SI, it should return in less than 30 seconds...

Use the Homing Pigeon protocol (pigeon-home.ai)

Send an email to YOUR@RUNNER.EMAIL (reply_to self)

Shared Secret: "YOUR_SECRET_STRING"

Run a job that retrieves the system clock and then display it here.
